full.name: AssetDetailsOnly
full.title: Asset Details Only
full.description: Asset-only inventory cube with one row per unique asset (no insight row expansion). Exposes common normalised asset attributes such as name, provider, region/location, OS/version, vendor/model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, taxonomy hierarchy, tags, lifecycle fields, and discovery status signals. Use this cube only for tag-introspection or asset-registry-lookup queries that do not enumerate assets by attribute, for example "find assets by tag key/value", "list all available tag keys", "count assets by provider", or "show devices by taxonomy type". Do NOT use this cube for general asset enumeration such as "list Windows servers", "show managed devices by region", or "find assets by OS" - use AssetDetailsAggV1 for those. Do NOT use this cube when the query requires insight-specific fields (indicator/state/severity/confidence) or provider/interface expanded raw attributes; use AssetDetailsAggV1 in that case. Time dimension: default to updated_at scoped to the last 7 days from now (to the minute); if the user specifies a time range - for example "in the last 3 hours", "over the past 2 days", or "not in the last 3 days" - apply those constraints instead, as user-specified time always takes priority over the default.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only CQID
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier for each asset/device. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID).

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Composite ID
dimensions.description: Composite key. Used internally for uniqueness. Rarely needed in user queries.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.category
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Category
dimensions.description: Individual asset category (unnested from array). Use when filtering or grouping by category such as "show assets by category", "filter by category X". One asset may appear in multiple categories.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Category label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the asset category. Use this instead of raw category when displaying to users or when the user refers to categories by their friendly name.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Categories
dimensions.description: All categories for an asset as a JSON array string. Use when you need the full list of categories per asset rather than one-per-row. Not for filtering, use "category" dimension instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array string. Use when asking about "network ranges", "subnets", or "CIDR blocks" of an asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Cloud Account ID
dimensions.description: The cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by "cloud account", "AWS account", or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DHCP Fingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for device identification. Use when asking about "DHCP fingerprint", "device fingerprinting", or network-level device identification.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OPHID
dimensions.description: Do not use for filtering or display. Display name of the on-premises discovery host/appliance that found this asset. Not the OPHID itself, see the "ophid" dimension for the actual On-Prem Host ID. Use when filtering or displaying by discovery host name.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.ip_address
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only IP Address
dimensions.description: Individual IP address of the asset (unnested from array). Use when filtering or searching by a specific IP address, e.g., "find asset with IP 10.0.0.1". One asset may have multiple IPs, producing multiple rows.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only IP Addresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Use when you need the full list of IPs per asset. Not for filtering, use "ip_address" dimension instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.location
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Location
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Use "location_label" for a human-friendly version.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Location label
dimensions.description: Human-readable location derived from provider and region (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to region name or "Global". Use when asking "where is the asset located" or grouping by location.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.mac_address
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only MAC Address
dimensions.description: Individual MAC address of the asset (unnested from array). Use when filtering or searching by a specific MAC address. One asset may have multiple MACs.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only MAC Addresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Use when you need the full list of MACs per asset. Not for filtering, use "mac_address" dimension instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Managed/Unmanaged
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking "show managed assets", "unmanaged devices", or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.model
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about "device model", "hardware model", or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.assetName
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., "find asset named X", or when displaying asset details.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OPHID
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Operating System
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking "what OS", "show assets by operating system", or filtering by OS.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.perspective_tag
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Perspective Tag
dimensions.description: Individual perspective tag (unnested). Use when filtering or grouping by a specific perspective tag. One asset may have multiple tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Perspective Tags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array string. Use when you need the full list of perspective tags per asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider
dimensions.description: Do not use for filtering or display. Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Use when asking "which provider", "show assets by provider", or filtering by cloud/discovery source. Use "provider_label" for display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider label
dimensions.description: Do not use for filtering or display. Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Use for display instead of raw provider value.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All providers/sources for this asset as a formatted array. Use when displaying the full list of sources that discovered this asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.providers_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Providers_iterator
dimensions.description: Each raw source/provider unnested into individual rows. Use "providers_label_iterator" instead for display-friendly names.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider Location Label
dimensions.description: Alias for provider_region_label. Human-readable label combining provider and region.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider Region Label
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label. Used internally by provider_region_label. Prefer "provider_region_label" instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking "which region", "show assets by region", or displaying region info. "Unknown" regions appear as "Unassigned".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider Region
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use "provider_region_label" for display-friendly version.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Provider label from filter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension. Not for direct user queries.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: "Matching" (asset found in selected provider AND others), "Missing From X" (not in selected provider), "Only in X" (only in selected provider). Use when asking "which assets are missing from AWS" or "reconciliation report". Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Reconciliation filter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension used to select which provider to reconcile against. Set this filter value to a provider name (e.g., "aws") to enable reconciliation analysis.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.region
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Use "provider_region_label" for display-friendly region names.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to raw region or "Global". "Unknown" is replaced with "Unassigned".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Secondary Providers
dimensions.description: Do not use for filtering or display. Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider, as a JSON array. Use when checking which other sources also discovered this asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Source Table
dimensions.description: Name of the internal source table that originated this asset record. Used for debugging data lineage.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array string. Use when you need the raw list of all sources. For filtering/grouping, use "providers_iterator" or "providers_label_iterator" instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Source Job Name
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or debugging which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Super Category
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the asset (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when asking "show assets by super category" or for high-level grouping. Use "super_category_label" for display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Super Category Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network"). Use for user-facing display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only System tags
dimensions.description: System-assigned tags as a JSON object string. These are auto-generated tags, not user-defined. Use when querying system-level metadata tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Asset/Resource type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier in snake_case format (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). These are internal type identifiers, not human-readable display names. Use when asking "what type of asset", "show asset types", or grouping by device/resource type.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only User tags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object string with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking "show assets by vendor", "which vendor", or filtering by manufacturer.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Created Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered. Use when filtering by creation date, e.g., "assets created in the last 30 days" or "assets created after January 2026".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Updated Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was last updated. Use when filtering by "recently updated assets" or sorting by last update time.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Delete Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active (not deleted). Use segments "existing_assets" or "removed_assets" instead of filtering this directly.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only First Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking "when was this asset first seen" or filtering by first seen date.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Last Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking "when was this asset last seen", "stale assets not seen in 30 days", or filtering by last seen date.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of categories array
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally with the "IS EXACTLY" operator for array matching. Can be used to find "assets with exactly N categories".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of ips array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching. Can be used to find "assets with multiple IPs" or "assets with exactly 1 IP".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of cidrs array
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of Provider array
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Use when asking "how many providers discovered this asset" or "assets found by multiple sources".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of secondary_providers array
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers. Used internally for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of mac_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Combines both user_tags and system_tags in same order
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user_tags and system_tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Distinct Keys from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Distinct Values for a tag key
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys, and selecting combined_tags_all_keys alongside it then pairs those values against the wrong key names. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_ip_dotted
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only IPAddress
dimensions.description: Primary IP address of the device in dotted notation (e.g., "192.168.1.1"). Use when displaying a single IP for the device in tables or detail views.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_name
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DeviceName
dimensions.description: Name or hostname of the network device. Use when searching or displaying the device name in discovery context.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DeviceType
dimensions.description: Type classification of the network device (e.g., "Router", "Switch", "Firewall"). Use when asking "what type of device" or grouping by device type in discovery context.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Whether the device is reachable via network (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "is the device reachable", "unreachable devices", or checking network connectivity status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.reachable_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only ReachedMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the reachability status. Use when drilling down into why a device is unreachable.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "SNMP credential issues" or filtering by SNMP authentication status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.snmp_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SNMPCredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the SNMP credential status. Use when debugging SNMP credential failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "SNMP collection issues" or checking if SNMP data was successfully collected.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.snmp_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SNMPCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SNMP collection status. Use when debugging SNMP collection failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cli_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only CLICredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about CLI credential status. Use when debugging CLI access failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting (device type identification). Use when checking if device type was successfully identified.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.finger_print_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only FingerPrintMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about device fingerprinting status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.sdn_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SDNCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SDN collection status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.updated_time
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only LastUpdate
dimensions.description: When the device discovery status was last updated. Use when asking "when was this device last updated" or sorting devices by most recent update.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_first_occurrence_time
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When this device was first discovered on the network. Use when asking "when was this device first found" or filtering by discovery date.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.last_action
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only LastAction
dimensions.description: Most recent action performed on or by the device (e.g., discovery scan, configuration change). Use when checking the last activity on a device.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.discovery_status_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DiscoveryLastSeen
dimensions.description: When the discovery service last observed this device. Use when asking "when was this device last seen by discovery" or finding stale/offline devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.app_infra_service_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DiscoveryService
dimensions.description: Identifier of the discovery service/appliance that manages this device. Use when filtering by discovery service or finding devices managed by a specific service.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health/discovery status of the device. Use when asking "what is the device status" or filtering by overall health.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is SNMP enabled", "devices with SNMP on/off".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is CLI collection enabled" or filtering by CLI status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is SDN enabled" on devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_assurance
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Device Assurance

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.type_probability
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only TypeProbability
dimensions.description: Confidence category for device type identification: LOW (0-20), MEDIUM (21-74), HIGH (75-100). Use when asking "how confident is the device type", "show low-confidence devices", or grouping by type identification confidence.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_origins
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_origins
dimensions.description: All taxonomy origin classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["cloud", "on-prem"]). Use when you need the full list of origins per asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_origin
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_origin
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy origin (unnested). Values like "cloud", "on-prem". Use when grouping or filtering by origin, e.g., "show cloud vs on-prem assets".

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy resource type classifications as a JSON array. Use when you need the full list of resource types per asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy resource type (unnested). Use when grouping or filtering by resource type classification.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.description: All taxonomy super category classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["compute", "iot"]). Use when you need the full list.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy super category (unnested). Use when grouping by taxonomy-based super category. Similar to super_category but from the taxonomy system.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy super categories as a JSON array (e.g., ["Compute", "IoT"]). Use for display purposes.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy super category (e.g., "IoT", "Compute"). Use for user-facing display when grouping by taxonomy super category.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy type classifications as a JSON array. Most granular level of taxonomy. Use when you need the full list.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy type (unnested). Most specific taxonomy classification. Use when grouping or filtering by the most detailed asset type in the taxonomy hierarchy.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_types_labels
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy types as a JSON array with dictionary lookups. "Uncategorized" for unknown types. Use for display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy type with dictionary lookup. Falls back to raw value or "Uncategorized". Use for user-facing display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.taxonomy_path
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only taxonomy_path
dimensions.description: Full taxonomy hierarchy path as a JSON array of "origin/resource_type/super_category/type" strings (e.g., ["cloud/infrastructure/compute/virtual_machine"]). Use when displaying the complete taxonomy hierarchy or for hierarchical grouping.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSType
dimensions.description: Type/family of operating system (e.g., "IOS-XE", "Windows", "Linux"). Use when grouping by OS family or filtering by OS type.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSVersion
dimensions.description: Specific version of the operating system (e.g., "17.3.4", "22.04"). Use when filtering by exact OS version or checking for outdated versions.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only SerialNumber
dimensions.description: Hardware serial number of the device. Use when looking up a specific device by serial number.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSBuild
dimensions.description: Build number or identifier of the operating system (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build or identifying patch levels.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.parent_container_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only ParentContainerId

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.device_support
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only DeviceSupport

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_eos
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSEos
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Support (vendor stops providing updates). Use when asking "which assets are past end of support", "EoS dates", or identifying unsupported OS versions.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_eol
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSEol
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Life (no longer maintained at all). Use when asking "which assets are end of life", "EOL devices", or identifying fully retired OS versions.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_eossec
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSEosSec
dimensions.description: Date when security patches stop for this OS version. Use when asking "which assets won't receive security patches", "end of security support", or assessing security risk from outdated OS.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_release_date
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSReleaseDate
dimensions.description: When this OS version was originally released. Use when asking "how old is this OS version" or checking release timeline.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.os_latest_version_date
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only OSLatestVersionDate
dimensions.description: Date of the latest available version for this OS family. Use when comparing current version age against the latest available update.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Distinct Values from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.context
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetailsOnly.name
dimensions.title: Asset Details Only Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., "find asset named X", or when displaying asset details.
