dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.mac_addresses

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Managed

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.model

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.os

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.perspective_tags

dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label

dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking 'which region', 'show assets by region', or displaying location. For raw region codes, see provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use when filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly version, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Providerlabelfromfilter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter value. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension for formatting. For provider display names, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: 'Matching' (found in selected provider and others), 'Missing From X', 'Only in X'. Use when asking 'which assets are missing from AWS' or 'reconciliation report'. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Reconciliationfilter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region for region filtering and provider_region_label for display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.resource

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.severities

dimensions.description: Array of insight severity levels for this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Values include "critical", "high", "medium", "low".

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.source_table

dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural dimension for internal tracking.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.providers

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.source_job_name

dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or checking which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.user_tags

dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system-generated tags, see system_tags. For merged tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking 'show assets by vendor', 'which vendor', or filtering by manufacturer.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.violations
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Violations
dimensions.description: Array of violation flags for each insight on this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. All insights in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) FirstSync
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, e.g., 'assets created in the last 30 days'. For first network observation, see first_seen. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) LastSync
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated in the system. Use when filtering by 'recently updated assets' or sorting by last update time. For last network observation, see last_seen. For creation time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) DeleteTime
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments 'existing_assets' or 'removed_assets' instead of filtering this directly. For creation time, see created_at. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.effective_change_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Effective Change At
dimensions.description: Latest lifecycle timestamp for the asset (greatest of created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Used as the delta sync sort key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsKeys
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValues
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.rowCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Row Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded)
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes, network interface attributes, and provider-specific raw attributes. This non-aggregated version keeps detailed insight rows, so one asset can produce multiple rows across indicators/rules and joined provider/interface records. Use this cube when a query needs the broadest field coverage across asset + insight + interface + provider domains in one result set. Example queries: "show unacknowledged high-severity insights for assets where interface is trunk and provider model matches X", "find assets with insight state active, provider tags containing Y, and interface VLAN Z", or "compare provider OS/version with interface telemetry for impacted assets". Do NOT use this cube for simple asset-only or insight-only analysis; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for better simplicity and performance.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) CQID
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier for each asset/device. The canonical asset ID across all discovery sources. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID).

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Composite ID
dimensions.description: Internal composite key combining account and asset identifiers for row-level uniqueness. Structural primary key for the cube. Use when deduplicating or identifying unique rows.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Type_old
dimensions.description: Individual asset category (unnested from array). One asset may appear in multiple categories, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or grouping by category. For display names, use category_label. For the full list per asset, use categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Type_old_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the asset category. Use for display instead of category. For filtering or grouping by category, use category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Type_oldies
dimensions.description: All categories for an asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when you need the full list of categories per asset. For filtering or grouping, use category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array string. Use when asking about network ranges, subnets, or CIDR blocks of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Cloud Account ID
dimensions.description: The cloud provider account identifier (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by cloud account or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DHCP Fingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for device identification on the network. Use when asking about DHCP fingerprint or network-level device identification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. Represents the appliance name, not the OPHID identifier. For the On-Prem Host ID, use ophid instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.indicator_rule_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Indicator Rule ID
dimensions.description: Unique ID of the insight indicator rule that triggered the finding. More specific than insight_indicator, identifying the exact rule version. Use when filtering by a specific insight rule.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Classification
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the security insight (e.g., "registration", "security"). Use when asking about insight type or grouping by classification. For display names, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Classification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight classification. Use for display instead of insight_classification. For combined classification and confidence, use insight_classification_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_classification_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight Classification and Confidence label
dimensions.description: Combined label showing both the insight classification and confidence level (e.g., "Security High"). Use when grouping by the combination of insight type and confidence. For classification alone, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_confidence
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight Confidence
dimensions.description: Confidence level of the insight finding (e.g., high, medium, low). Use when asking about insight confidence, filtering by confidence, or grouping insights by confidence level. For display names, use insight_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight Confidence label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight confidence level. Use for display instead of insight_confidence. For filtering or grouping by confidence, use insight_confidence.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight Indicator
dimensions.description: Specific indicator that triggered the insight, identifying a particular security check. Use when asking which indicator or check failed. For display names, use insight_indicator_label. For rule-level detail, use indicator_rule_id.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the insight indicator. Use for display instead of insight_indicator. For registration-specific indicators, use insight_registration_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Registration Indicator
dimensions.description: Indicator ID only for registration-type insights. Empty for non-registration insights. Use when querying registration-related indicators. For its display name, use insight_registration_indicator_label. For all insight indicators, use insight_indicator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Registration Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the registration indicator. Use for display instead of insight_registration_indicator. For general insight indicator labels, use insight_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_registration_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Registration Status
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is registered or unregistered based on registration-type insights. Values: "registered", "unregistered", or empty. Use when asking about registration status. For display, use insight_registration_status_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_registration_status_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Registration Status Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display label for registration status (e.g., "Registered", "Unregistered"). Use for display instead of insight_registration_status. For filtering, use insight_registration_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_state
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insight State
dimensions.description: Current state of the insight (e.g., "active", "none"). Use when asking whether an insight is active, filtering by insight state, or checking current insight status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_sub_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SubClassification
dimensions.description: Detailed sub-classification of the insight within its parent classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or grouping by sub-classification. For display names, use insight_sub_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insight_sub_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SubClassification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight sub-classification. Use for display instead of insight_sub_classification. For filtering or grouping, use insight_sub_classification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.ip_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) IP Address
dimensions.description: Individual IP address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple IPs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific IP address, e.g., "find asset with IP 10.0.0.1". For the full list per asset, use ip_addresses. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Ips for Filter

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) IP Addresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual IP, use ip_address instead. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Location
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. For human-readable location names, use location_label instead. For region-specific location with provider context, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Location label
dimensions.description: Human-readable location derived from provider and region (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to region name or "Global". Use when asking where an asset is located. For provider-qualified region, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.mac_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) MAC Address
dimensions.description: Individual MAC address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple MACs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific MAC address. For the full list per asset, use mac_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) MAC Addresses

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.managed

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.providers_label

dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.providers_iterator

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.provider_region_label_old

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.provider_region_label

dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking about asset region, showing assets by region, or displaying region info. For raw region code, use provider_region. For location without provider prefix, use location_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Provider Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use for filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly region names, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: "Matching" (found in selected provider AND others), "Missing From X" (not in selected provider), "Only in X" (only in selected provider). Use when asking which assets are missing from a provider. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Reconciliation filter

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.region

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.region_label

dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Hidden structural field. For region display, use provider_region_label instead, which includes provider context.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Resource
dimensions.description: Full asset record from the source as a JSON string. Use when inspecting the raw asset payload or looking up fields not exposed as dedicated dimensions. Primarily for internal compatibility.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Secondary Providers
dimensions.description: Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider as a JSON array. Primarily for internal compatibility. For all sources with display labels, use providers_label_iterator. For primary source, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.severity
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Severity
dimensions.description: Severity level of the insight (e.g., "critical", "high", "medium", "low"). Use when asking about insight severity, filtering by severity, or grouping insights by severity level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Source Table
dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural field indicating the origin of the asset record.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual source, use providers_iterator or providers_label_iterator instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Source Job Name
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or identifying which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level asset classification (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when grouping by high-level asset type. For display, use super_category_label. For taxonomy-based classification, use taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Super Category Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network"). Use for display instead of super_category. For taxonomy-based labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) System tags
dimensions.description: System-generated tags as a JSON object string. Auto-assigned metadata tags. Use when querying system-level tags. For user-defined tags, use user_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Asset/Resource type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Internal type identifiers. Primarily for internal compatibility. For taxonomy-based asset types, use taxonomy_type or taxonomy_type_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) User tags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object string with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system tags, use system_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking about asset vendor, manufacturer, or grouping by vendor.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.violated
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Violated
dimensions.description: Whether the insight rule was violated (true/false). All rows in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out. Structural field indicating active violations.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Created Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, such as assets created in the last 30 days. For when the asset was first observed on the network, use first_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Updated Time
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated. Use when filtering by recently updated assets or sorting by last update time. For device discovery update time specifically, use updated_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Delete Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments existing_assets or removed_assets instead of filtering this directly.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) First Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking when an asset was first seen. For asset creation time in the system, use created_at. For device first discovery time, use device_first_occurrence_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Last Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking about stale assets or filtering by last seen date. For discovery service last check time, use discovery_status_last_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_categories_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of categories array
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with a specific number of categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of ips array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with multiple IPs or exactly one IP.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_di_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of di_ip_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses assigned to this interface. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of cidrs array
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of Provider array
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking how many providers discovered this asset or finding assets found by multiple sources.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of secondary_providers array
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers for the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of mac_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Combines both user_tags and system_tags in same order
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user_tags and system_tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Distinct Keys from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Distinct Values for a tag key
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys, and selecting combined_tags_all_keys alongside it then pairs those values against the wrong key names. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Users
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking how many users logged into a device, finding devices with most users, or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_ip_dotted
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) IPAddress
dimensions.description: Primary IP address of the device in dotted notation (e.g., "192.168.1.1"). One IP per device for display in tables. For all asset IPs or IP-based filtering, use ip_address. For the full IP list, use ip_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DeviceName
dimensions.description: Device hostname from network discovery context. Use when displaying or filtering by the network discovery device name. For the general asset display name, use name instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DeviceType
dimensions.description: Type classification of the network device (e.g., "Router", "Switch", "Firewall"). Use when asking about device type or grouping by device type. For confidence in the type identification, use type_probability.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Network reachability status of the device (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking if a device is reachable or filtering by connectivity status. For details, use reachable_message. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.reachable_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) ReachedMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the reachability status. Use when drilling down into why a device is unreachable. For the status summary, use reachable_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP credential issues or filtering by SNMP authentication status. For details, use snmp_credential_message. For collection status, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.snmp_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SNMPCredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the SNMP credential status. Use when debugging SNMP credential failures. For the status summary, use snmp_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP collection issues. For details, use snmp_collection_message. For credential status, use snmp_credential_status. For whether collection is enabled, use snmp_collection_enabled.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.snmp_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SNMPCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SNMP collection status. Use when debugging SNMP collection failures. For the status summary, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices. For details, use cli_credential_message. For whether CLI collection is enabled, use cli_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cli_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) CLICredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about CLI credential status. Use when debugging CLI access failures. For the status summary, use cli_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting (device type identification). Use when checking if device type was successfully identified. For details, use finger_print_message. For the confidence level, use type_probability. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.finger_print_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) FingerPrintMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about device fingerprinting status. Use when debugging fingerprinting failures. For the status summary, use finger_print_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status. For details, use sdn_collection_message. For whether SDN collection is enabled, use sdn_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.sdn_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SDN collection status. Use when debugging SDN collection failures. For the status summary, use sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.updated_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) LastUpdate
dimensions.description: When the device discovery status was last updated. Use when asking about last device update or sorting devices by most recent update. For the asset record update time, use updated_at instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_first_occurrence_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When this device was first discovered via network scanning. Use when asking when a device was first found. For the asset-level first seen time, use first_seen instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.last_action
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) LastAction
dimensions.description: Most recent action performed on or by the device (e.g., discovery scan, configuration change). Use when checking the last activity on a device.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.discovery_status_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DiscoveryLastSeen
dimensions.description: When the discovery service last observed this device. Use when finding stale or offline devices. For the asset-level last seen time, use last_seen instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.app_infra_service_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DiscoveryService
dimensions.description: Identifier of the discovery service/appliance that manages this device. Use when filtering by discovery service or finding devices managed by a specific service.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health/discovery status of the device, summarizing protocol-specific checks. Use when asking about device status or filtering by overall health. For individual protocol status, use reachable_status, snmp_collection_status, cli_credential_status, or sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if SNMP is enabled or filtering by SNMP on/off. For SNMP collection results, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if CLI collection is enabled or filtering by CLI on/off. For CLI credential results, use cli_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if SDN is enabled. For SDN collection results, use sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_assurance
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Device Assurance
dimensions.description: Numeric confidence score (0-100) for device type identification. Hidden internal field used to derive type_probability. For the categorized confidence level, use type_probability instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.type_probability
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) TypeProbability
dimensions.description: Confidence category for device type identification: LOW (0-20), MEDIUM (21-74), HIGH (75-100). Use when asking about device type confidence or filtering by identification reliability. Derived from device_assurance score.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_origins
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_origins
dimensions.description: All taxonomy origin classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["cloud", "on-prem"]). Use when you need the full list of origins per asset. For filtering or grouping by individual origin, use taxonomy_origin instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_origin
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_origin
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy origin (unnested). Values like "cloud", "on-prem". Use when grouping or filtering by origin, e.g., "show cloud vs on-prem assets". For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_origins.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy resource type classifications as a JSON array. Use when you need the full list of resource types per asset. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_resource_type instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy resource type classification (unnested). Use when grouping or filtering by resource type classification. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_resource_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Category
dimensions.description: All taxonomy super category classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["compute", "iot"]). Use when you need the full list per asset. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_super_category. For display labels, use taxonomy_super_categories_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) LengthOfTaxonomySuperCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy super categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy-based super category (unnested). Use when grouping by taxonomy super category. For the legacy classification, use super_category. For display, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy super categories as a JSON array (e.g., ["Compute", "IoT"]). For individual labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For raw values, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy super category (e.g., "IoT", "Compute"). Use for display. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_super_category. For legacy super category display, use super_category_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Type
dimensions.description: All taxonomy type classifications as a JSON array. Most granular level of taxonomy. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_type instead. For display labels, use taxonomy_types_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) LengthOfTaxonomyTypesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy types assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy type (unnested). Most specific taxonomy classification. Use when grouping or filtering by the most detailed asset type. For display, use taxonomy_type_label. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_types_labels
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy types as a JSON array. "Uncategorized" for unknown types. For individual type labels, use taxonomy_type_label. For raw values, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy type. Falls back to raw value or "Uncategorized". Use for display. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_type instead. For internal type identifiers, use display_type.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.taxonomy_path
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) taxonomy_path
dimensions.description: Full taxonomy hierarchy path as a JSON array of "origin/resource_type/super_category/type" strings (e.g., ["cloud/infrastructure/compute/virtual_machine"]). Use when displaying the complete taxonomy hierarchy or for hierarchical grouping.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSType
dimensions.description: OS family/type (e.g., "IOS-XE", "Windows", "Linux"). Use when grouping by OS family or filtering by OS type. For the full OS name, use os. For the specific version, use os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSVersion
dimensions.description: Specific version of the operating system (e.g., "17.3.4", "22.04"). Use when filtering by exact OS version or checking for outdated versions. For the full OS name, use os. For the OS family, use os_type.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) SerialNumber
dimensions.description: Hardware serial number of the device. Use when looking up a specific device by serial number.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSBuild
dimensions.description: Build number or identifier of the operating system (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build or identifying patch levels.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.parent_container_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) ParentContainerId
dimensions.description: Identifier of the parent container this asset belongs to, when the asset was discovered as part of a container or virtualization hierarchy. Empty for standalone assets. Use when associating assets with their parent container.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.device_support
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) DeviceSupport
dimensions.description: Device support status reported by discovery, indicating whether the device is supported for detailed discovery collection. Use when filtering assets by discovery support status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_eos
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSEos
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Support (vendor stops providing updates). Use when asking about end of support dates or identifying assets with unsupported OS versions.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_eol
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSEol
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Life (no longer maintained). Use when asking about end of life devices or identifying fully retired OS versions.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_eossec
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSEosSec
dimensions.description: Date when security patches stop for this OS version. Use when asking about end of security support or assessing security risk from outdated OS.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_release_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSReleaseDate
dimensions.description: When this OS version was originally released. Use when asking about OS version age or checking release timeline.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.os_latest_version_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) OSLatestVersionDate
dimensions.description: Date of the latest available version for this OS family. Use when comparing current version age against the latest available update.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Distinct Values from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

measures.description: Total number of rows including asset-insight combinations. One asset may produce multiple rows if it has multiple insights. Use when asking about total records or row counts. For unique asset count, use assetsCount. For assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.assetsCount

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insightsCount

measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one active security insight or violation. Use when asking how many assets have insights or violations. For all unique assets, use assetsCount. For total rows, use count.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets. Use when asking about asset distribution or share of assets grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentage, use percent. For insight percentage, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking about insight distribution grouped by a dimension. For asset distribution, use assetsPercent. For row percentage, use percent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data (Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of rows including asset-insight combinations. One asset may produce multiple rows if it has multiple insights. Use when asking about total records or row counts. For unique asset count, use assetsCount. For assets with insights, use insightsCount.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded)
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with network interface data, raw provider discovery data, and per-user identity data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; (3) network interface attributes -- interface details like VRF names, IP addresses, MAC addresses, etc.; (4) raw provider attributes -- per-provider name, categories, OS, vendor, model, serial number, IPs, MACs, location, last seen, tags, pd_standardized_json_attributes, and the full pd_raw_json blob; and (5) user identity fields -- first/last name, login ID, email, provider, and per-action provider map for the most recent user who logged on in the last 7 days. Use this cube when a query needs asset + interface + provider + user domains together -- for example "show assets with VPC interface and provider data where a specific user recently logged on". Do NOT use this cube for queries where user, interface, or provider data is not needed; prefer simpler cubes for those cases.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) IndicatorRuleID
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator rule IDs that triggered findings for this asset. Used for programmatic filtering of specific insight rules. For indicator identifiers, use insight_indicators; for display names, use insight_indicators_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsKeys
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValues
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.
