measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.rowCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Row Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded)
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes, network interface attributes, provider-specific raw attributes, and per-user identity data. Grain is one row per asset-insight combination. Use this cube when a query needs the broadest field coverage across asset + insight + interface + provider + user domains in one result set. Example queries: "show high-severity insights for assets where interface is trunk and logged-on user matches X", "find assets with active insight, provider tags containing Y, and interface VLAN Z with recent user logon". Do NOT use this cube for simple asset-only or insight-only analysis; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for better simplicity and performance.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) CQID
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier for each asset/device. The canonical asset ID across all discovery sources. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID).

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Composite ID
dimensions.description: Internal composite key combining account and asset identifiers for row-level uniqueness. Structural primary key for the cube. Use when deduplicating or identifying unique rows.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Type_old
dimensions.description: Individual asset category (unnested from array). One asset may appear in multiple categories, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or grouping by category. For display names, use category_label. For the full list per asset, use categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Type_old_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the asset category. Use for display instead of category. For filtering or grouping by category, use category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Type_oldies
dimensions.description: All categories for an asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when you need the full list of categories per asset. For filtering or grouping, use category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array string. Use when asking about network ranges, subnets, or CIDR blocks of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Cloud Account ID
dimensions.description: The cloud provider account identifier (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by cloud account or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) DHCP Fingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for device identification on the network. Use when asking about DHCP fingerprint or network-level device identification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. Represents the appliance name, not the OPHID identifier. For the On-Prem Host ID, use ophid instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.indicator_rule_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Indicator Rule ID
dimensions.description: Unique ID of the insight indicator rule that triggered the finding. More specific than insight_indicator, identifying the exact rule version. Use when filtering by a specific insight rule.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Classification
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the security insight (e.g., "registration", "security"). Use when asking about insight type or grouping by classification. For display names, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Classification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight classification. Use for display instead of insight_classification. For combined classification and confidence, use insight_classification_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_classification_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight Classification and Confidence label
dimensions.description: Combined label showing both the insight classification and confidence level (e.g., "Security High"). Use when grouping by the combination of insight type and confidence. For classification alone, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_confidence
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight Confidence
dimensions.description: Confidence level of the insight finding (e.g., high, medium, low). Use when asking about insight confidence, filtering by confidence, or grouping insights by confidence level. For display names, use insight_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight Confidence label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight confidence level. Use for display instead of insight_confidence. For filtering or grouping by confidence, use insight_confidence.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight Indicator
dimensions.description: Specific indicator that triggered the insight, identifying a particular security check. Use when asking which indicator or check failed. For display names, use insight_indicator_label. For rule-level detail, use indicator_rule_id.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the insight indicator. Use for display instead of insight_indicator. For registration-specific indicators, use insight_registration_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Registration Indicator
dimensions.description: Indicator ID only for registration-type insights. Empty for non-registration insights. Use when querying registration-related indicators. For its display name, use insight_registration_indicator_label. For all insight indicators, use insight_indicator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Registration Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the registration indicator. Use for display instead of insight_registration_indicator. For general insight indicator labels, use insight_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_registration_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Registration Status
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is registered or unregistered based on registration-type insights. Values: "registered", "unregistered", or empty. Use when asking about registration status. For display, use insight_registration_status_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_registration_status_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Registration Status Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display label for registration status (e.g., "Registered", "Unregistered"). Use for display instead of insight_registration_status. For filtering, use insight_registration_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_state
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insight State
dimensions.description: Current state of the insight (e.g., "active", "none"). Use when asking whether an insight is active, filtering by insight state, or checking current insight status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_sub_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SubClassification
dimensions.description: Detailed sub-classification of the insight within its parent classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or grouping by sub-classification. For display names, use insight_sub_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insight_sub_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SubClassification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight sub-classification. Use for display instead of insight_sub_classification. For filtering or grouping, use insight_sub_classification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ip_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) IP Address
dimensions.description: Individual IP address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple IPs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific IP address, e.g., "find asset with IP 10.0.0.1". For the full list per asset, use ip_addresses. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization. Structural field used by the query builder infrastructure. For IP-based filtering or display, use ip_address or device_ip_dotted instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) IP Addresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual IP, use ip_address instead. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Location
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. For human-readable location names, use location_label instead. For region-specific location with provider context, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Location label
dimensions.description: Human-readable location derived from provider and region (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to region name or "Global". Use when asking where an asset is located. For provider-qualified region, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.mac_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) MAC Address
dimensions.description: Individual MAC address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple MACs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific MAC address. For the full list per asset, use mac_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) MAC Addresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual MAC, use mac_address instead.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Model

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name or displaying asset details. For network discovery device name specifically, use device_name.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Perspective Tags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual tag, use perspective_tag instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider
dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Use when filtering or grouping by provider. For display names, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers_label_iterator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider label
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Use for display instead of provider. For all sources with labels, use providers_label_iterator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All providers/sources for this asset as a formatted array with display labels. Use when displaying the full list of sources per asset. For individual source grouping, use providers_label_iterator. For a single primary source, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.providers_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Providers_iterator
dimensions.description: Each raw source/provider unnested into individual rows. Use for filtering by any discovery source. For display-friendly names, use providers_label_iterator instead. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider Location Label
dimensions.description: Alias for provider_region_label. Human-readable label combining provider and region. For the canonical region label, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider Region Label
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label. Used internally by provider_region_label. For region display, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking about asset region, showing assets by region, or displaying region info. For raw region code, use provider_region. For location without provider prefix, use location_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use for filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly region names, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Provider label from filter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension. For general provider display, use provider_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: "Matching" (found in selected provider AND others), "Missing From X" (not in selected provider), "Only in X" (only in selected provider). Use when asking which assets are missing from a provider. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Reconciliation filter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter value to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. For display-friendly region names, use provider_region_label. For raw region with provider context, use provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Hidden structural field. For region display, use provider_region_label instead, which includes provider context.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Resource
dimensions.description: Full asset record from the source as a JSON string. Use when inspecting the raw asset payload or looking up fields not exposed as dedicated dimensions. Primarily for internal compatibility.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.secondary_providers

dimensions.description: Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider as a JSON array. Primarily for internal compatibility. For all sources with display labels, use providers_label_iterator. For primary source, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.severity
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Severity
dimensions.description: Severity level of the insight (e.g., "critical", "high", "medium", "low"). Use when asking about insight severity, filtering by severity, or grouping insights by severity level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Source Table
dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural field indicating the origin of the asset record.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual source, use providers_iterator or providers_label_iterator instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Source Job Name
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or identifying which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level asset classification (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when grouping by high-level asset type. For display, use super_category_label. For taxonomy-based classification, use taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Super Category Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network"). Use for display instead of super_category. For taxonomy-based labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) System tags
dimensions.description: System-generated tags as a JSON object string. Auto-assigned metadata tags. Use when querying system-level tags. For user-defined tags, use user_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.display_type

dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Internal type identifiers. Primarily for internal compatibility. For taxonomy-based asset types, use taxonomy_type or taxonomy_type_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) User tags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object string with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system tags, use system_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking about asset vendor, manufacturer, or grouping by vendor.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.violated
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Violated
dimensions.description: Whether the insight rule was violated (true/false). All rows in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out. Structural field indicating active violations.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Created Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, such as assets created in the last 30 days. For when the asset was first observed on the network, use first_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Updated Time
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated. Use when filtering by recently updated assets or sorting by last update time. For device discovery update time specifically, use updated_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Delete Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments existing_assets or removed_assets instead of filtering this directly.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) First Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking when an asset was first seen. For asset creation time in the system, use created_at. For device first discovery time, use device_first_occurrence_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Last Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking about stale assets or filtering by last seen date. For discovery service last check time, use discovery_status_last_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_categories_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of categories array
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with a specific number of categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of ips array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with multiple IPs or exactly one IP.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_di_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of di_ip_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses assigned to this interface. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of cidrs array
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of Provider array
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking how many providers discovered this asset or finding assets found by multiple sources.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of secondary_providers array
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers for the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of mac_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Combines both user_tags and system_tags in same order
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user_tags and system_tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Distinct Keys from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Distinct Values for a tag key
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys, and selecting combined_tags_all_keys alongside it then pairs those values against the wrong key names. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Users
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking how many users logged into a device, finding devices with most users, or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Name
dimensions.description: First name of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Derived from the first token of user_name in composite_user. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_last_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Last Name
dimensions.description: Last name of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Derived from the second token of user_name in composite_user. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_login_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Login ID
dimensions.description: Login/username of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when filtering or searching by username or logon ID.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_email
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Email
dimensions.description: Email address of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when asking about user email or looking up users by email.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Provider
dimensions.description: Identity provider that authenticated the user (e.g., "Azure AD", "Okta"). Use when filtering logon activity by identity provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_last_logon
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Last Logon
dimensions.description: Most recent logon timestamp of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when asking "when did the user last log in", sorting by recent logon activity, or filtering by logon date. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_providers_by_action
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Ud Providers by Action
dimensions.description: JSON map of logon action to provider list for this user-device pair (e.g., {"login": ["Azure AD"]}). Use when inspecting per-action provider detail for user logon activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.ud_provider_list
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Providers
dimensions.description: Flat deduplicated list of providers captured on asset-user association events, returned as a JSON array (for example, ["CrowdStrike Falcon","nios"]).

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_ud_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) LengthOfAssociationProviderArray
dimensions.description: Count of distinct providers captured on asset-user association events. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking 'how many providers are associated with this user-device pair'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.device_ip_dotted
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) IPAddress
dimensions.description: Primary IP address of the device in dotted notation (e.g., "192.168.1.1"). One IP per device for display in tables. For all asset IPs or IP-based filtering, use ip_address. For the full IP list, use ip_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.device_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) DeviceName
dimensions.description: Device hostname from network discovery context. Use when displaying or filtering by the network discovery device name. For the general asset display name, use name instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.device_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) DeviceType
dimensions.description: Type classification of the network device (e.g., "Router", "Switch", "Firewall"). Use when asking about device type or grouping by device type. For confidence in the type identification, use type_probability.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Network reachability status of the device (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking if a device is reachable or filtering by connectivity status. For details, use reachable_message. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.reachable_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) ReachedMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the reachability status. Use when drilling down into why a device is unreachable. For the status summary, use reachable_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP credential issues or filtering by SNMP authentication status. For details, use snmp_credential_message. For collection status, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.snmp_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SNMPCredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the SNMP credential status. Use when debugging SNMP credential failures. For the status summary, use snmp_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP collection issues. For details, use snmp_collection_message. For credential status, use snmp_credential_status. For whether collection is enabled, use snmp_collection_enabled.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.snmp_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SNMPCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SNMP collection status. Use when debugging SNMP collection failures. For the status summary, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices. For details, use cli_credential_message. For whether CLI collection is enabled, use cli_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cli_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) CLICredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about CLI credential status. Use when debugging CLI access failures. For the status summary, use cli_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting (device type identification). Use when checking if device type was successfully identified. For details, use finger_print_message. For the confidence level, use type_probability. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.finger_print_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) FingerPrintMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about device fingerprinting status. Use when debugging fingerprinting failures. For the status summary, use finger_print_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status. For details, use sdn_collection_message. For whether SDN collection is enabled, use sdn_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.sdn_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SDN collection status. Use when debugging SDN collection failures. For the status summary, use sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.updated_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) LastUpdate
dimensions.description: When the device discovery status was last updated. Use when asking about last device update or sorting devices by most recent update. For the asset record update time, use updated_at instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.device_first_occurrence_time

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.last_action
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) LastAction

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.discovery_status_last_seen

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.overall_status

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.cli_collection_enabled

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) SDNCollectionEnabled

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Distinct Values from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.name

measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Row Count
measures.description: Total number of rows including asset-insight combinations. One asset may produce multiple rows if it has multiple insights. Use when asking about total records or row counts. For unique asset count, use assetsCount. For assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of insights. Use when asking how many assets, devices, or total unique assets. For total rows, use count. For assets with insights only, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insightsCount

measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one active security insight or violation. Use when asking how many assets have insights or violations. For all unique assets, use assetsCount. For total rows, use count.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking about row-level percentage breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets. Use when asking about asset distribution or share of assets grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentage, use percent. For insight percentage, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking about insight distribution grouped by a dimension. For asset distribution, use assetsPercent. For row percentage, use percent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + Provider Data + User Data (Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of rows including asset-insight combinations. One asset may produce multiple rows if it has multiple insights. Use when asking about total records or row counts. For unique asset count, use assetsCount. For assets with insights, use insightsCount.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded)
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with network interface data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; and (3) network interface attributes -- interface details like VRF names, IP addresses, MAC addresses, etc. Use this cube when a query needs BOTH common asset attributes AND network interface attributes -- for example "show me assets with specific interface configurations", "list devices with their network interfaces", or "filter assets by interface properties". Do NOT use this cube for insight-only or asset-only queries where interface data is not needed; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for those cases.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightConfidenceslabel

dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator IDs for this asset. Each indicator represents a specific security check that was triggered. dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_indicators for display. For raw indicator IDs used in filtering, see insight_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) MissingRecords
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration-type insight indicators identifying missing records or registration issues. Use when asking 'what registration indicators' or 'missing records'. dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) RegistrationIndicatorslabel

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) RegistrationStatus
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration statuses for this asset (e.g., ["registered"], ["unregistered"]). Use when asking 'is the asset registered' or 'show unregistered assets'. dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Registration Statuses Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display labels for registration statuses (e.g., ["Registered"], ["Unregistered"]). Prefer this over insight_registration_statuses for display. For raw status values, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightStates
dimensions.description: Array of insight states (e.g., ["active", "none"]). Primarily for Builder compatibility. For filtering by insight type, prefer insight_classifications or insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SubClassifications
dimensions.description: Array of insight sub-classifications providing finer detail within a classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or filtering by sub-classification. For display labels, use insight_sub_classifications_label. For broader grouping, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SubClassifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight sub-classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_sub_classifications for display. For raw sub-classification values, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) IPAddresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about an asset's IP addresses or displaying the full list of IPs.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Ips for Filter

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) AssetLocation
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) MACAddresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'MAC addresses' or displaying hardware network identifiers per asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Managed
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking 'show managed assets', 'unmanaged devices', or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about 'device model', 'hardware model', or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetName
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Name

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) DiscoveryHost
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the display name, see discovery_host.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) OperatingSystem
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking 'what OS' or filtering by operating system. For the OS family, see os_type. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) PerspectiveTags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Provider
dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Raw internal value. For display, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer this over provider for display. For the raw value, see provider. For all sources, use providers_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All discovery providers for this asset as a formatted JSON array with proper casing. Use when displaying the full list of sources. For raw source values, see providers. For the single primary provider, see provider_label.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProvidersLabel

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProviderandLocationlabel_old

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location_label

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation_filter

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.region

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Resource

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SecondaryProviders

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array. Use when you need the raw list of all sources. For display-friendly labels, use providers_label. For the single primary provider, see provider.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SuperCategoryLabel

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsKeys
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValues
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.rowCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Row Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_UserData_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Device Interface + User Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.
