full.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded)
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with raw provider discovery data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; and (3) raw provider attributes -- per-provider name, categories, OS, vendor, model, serial number, IPs, MACs, location, last seen, tags, pd_standardized_json_attributes, and the full pd_raw_json blob. Use this cube when a query needs BOTH common asset attributes (shared across all providers) AND provider-specific attributes that are only available from a particular source -- for example "show me all Jamf Pro assets where disk encryption is enabled", "list AWS EC2 instances with their instance type and IAM role from the provider", or "show AWS EC2 instances with their VPC ID and security groups". Do NOT use this cube for insight-only or asset-only queries where provider raw data is not needed; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for those cases.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.deploymentContext
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment. Possible values: 'Cloud' (assets hosted on cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP) and 'Onprem' (assets discovered on-premises via BloxOne or network discovery). When the user asks for 'cloud assets' or 'cloud-hosted assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Cloud'. When the user asks for 'on-premises assets' or 'on-prem assets', filter deploymentContext = 'Onprem'. Do NOT use the Category dimension to distinguish cloud from on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) IndicatorRuleID
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator rule IDs that triggered findings for this asset. Used for programmatic filtering of specific insight rules. For indicator identifiers, use insight_indicators; for display names, use insight_indicators_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). Use when asking 'what types of insights' or grouping by insight classification. For display names, use insight_classifications_label. For finer detail, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_classifications for display. Use when the user asks about insight types by friendly name. For raw values, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Confidence
dimensions.description: Array of confidence levels for all insights on this asset (e.g., ["high", "medium"]). Use when asking about insight confidence levels or filtering assets by confidence. For display labels, use insight_confidences_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightConfidenceslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight confidence levels as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_confidences for display. For raw confidence values used in filtering, see insight_confidences.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator IDs for this asset. Each indicator represents a specific security check that was triggered. Use when asking 'which indicators' or filtering by indicator. For display names, use insight_indicators_label. For rule definitions, see indicator_rule_ids.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_indicators for display. For raw indicator IDs used in filtering, see insight_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) MissingRecords
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration-type insight indicators identifying missing records or registration issues. Use when asking 'what registration indicators' or 'missing records'. For display labels, use insight_registration_indicators_label. For registration status, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) RegistrationIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for registration indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this for display when showing missing records by friendly name. For raw indicator IDs, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) RegistrationStatus
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration statuses for this asset (e.g., ["registered"], ["unregistered"]). Use when asking 'is the asset registered' or 'show unregistered assets'. For display labels, use insight_registration_statuses_label. For which rules triggered, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Registration Statuses Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display labels for registration statuses (e.g., ["Registered"], ["Unregistered"]). Prefer this over insight_registration_statuses for display. For raw status values, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) InsightStates
dimensions.description: Array of insight states (e.g., ["active", "none"]). Primarily for Builder compatibility. For filtering by insight type, prefer insight_classifications or insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SubClassifications
dimensions.description: Array of insight sub-classifications providing finer detail within a classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or filtering by sub-classification. For display labels, use insight_sub_classifications_label. For broader grouping, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) SubClassifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight sub-classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_sub_classifications for display. For raw sub-classification values, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) IPAddresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about an asset's IP addresses or displaying the full list of IPs.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization on IP addresses. Used by the query builder infrastructure for efficient IP-based filtering.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) AssetLocation
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) MACAddresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'MAC addresses' or displaying hardware network identifiers per asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Managed
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking 'show managed assets', 'unmanaged devices', or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about 'device model', 'hardware model', or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.assetName
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) DiscoveryHost
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the display name, see discovery_host.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) OperatingSystem
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking 'what OS' or filtering by operating system. For the OS family, see os_type. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) PerspectiveTags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Provider
dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Raw internal value. For display, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer this over provider for display. For the raw value, see provider. For all sources, use providers_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All discovery providers for this asset as a formatted JSON array with proper casing. Use when displaying the full list of sources. For raw source values, see providers. For the single primary provider, see provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) ProviderandLocationlabel_old
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label (e.g., "AWS: us-east-1"). Used internally by provider_region_label. Prefer provider_region_label for current region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking 'which region', 'show assets by region', or displaying location. For raw region codes, see provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use when filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly version, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Providerlabelfromfilter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter value. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension for formatting. For provider display names, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: 'Matching' (found in selected provider and others), 'Missing From X', 'Only in X'. Use when asking 'which assets are missing from AWS' or 'reconciliation report'. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Reconciliationfilter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region for region filtering and provider_region_label for display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Resource
dimensions.description: Full raw asset record as a JSON string. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Use when the user wants to inspect the complete raw asset payload.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.secondary_providers

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.effective_change_at

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.first_seen

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.last_seen

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.user_count

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) LengthOfSecondaryProvidersArray

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_indicator_ids

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) LengthOfRegistrationStatusArray

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_subclassifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) LengthOfSubClassificationArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight sub-classifications for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Display only. Use when showing all tags for an asset. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the number of tags, or to find tagged and untagged assets, use length_combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsKeys
dimensions.description: A single tag key name from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct key. Use when asking what tags are available or listing tag keys, and for key suggestion lists. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the keys distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For tag values, use combined_tags_all_values or combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For the whole tag object of an asset, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Tag values belonging to one named tag key, returned as one row per distinct value. Requires a combined_tags_all_keys equals filter naming exactly one key. Exactly one key must be passed: the key is substituted into a single map lookup, so an in filter with several keys returns the values of only the first key plus a null for every asset that has one of the other keys. Use for value suggestion lists once a key has been chosen, one request per key. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped. For values across every key, use combined_tags_all_values. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Name
dimensions.description: Human-readable device name as reported by this provider. Use when asking about "device name" or "hostname" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Categories
dimensions.description: Categories associated with this asset as reported by this provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Os
dimensions.description: Operating system string reported by this provider. Use when asking about "OS" or "operating system" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Os Version

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Os Type

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Os Build
dimensions.description: OS build number reported by this provider (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Vendor

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Model
dimensions.description: Device model as reported by this provider. Use when asking about "model" or "hardware model" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Serial Number
dimensions.description: Device serial number as reported by this provider. Use when asking about "serial number" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Ip Addresses
dimensions.description: JSON array of IP addresses associated with this asset from this provider. Use when asking about "IP" or "IP address" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Mac Addresses
dimensions.description: JSON array of MAC addresses associated with this asset from this provider. Use when asking about "MAC address" or "physical address" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Location
dimensions.description: Geographic or network location of the asset as reported by this provider. Use when asking about "location" or "site" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Last Seen
dimensions.description: Timestamp when this provider last observed the asset. Null when the value is epoch zero. Use when asking "when was this asset last seen by a specific provider?".

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Tags
dimensions.description: JSON map of key-value tags. For provider rows these are provider-reported tags; for the common row they are the merged system_tags + user_tags. Use when asking about "tags" or "labels" at the provider level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_standardized_json_attributes
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Standardized Json Attributes
dimensions.description: Standardized JSON attributes from the provider data record.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_json_paths_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) JSON Paths Filter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension accepting comma-separated JSON paths to check existence in pd_standardized_json_attributes. Set this filter value (e.g., "fieldA,fieldB,nested.child") then query pd_json_paths_existence to see which paths exist. Query with ungrouped=true.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_json_paths_existence
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) JSON Paths Existence
dimensions.description: Returns a JSON map of {path: "true"/"false"} indicating whether each requested path exists in pd_standardized_json_attributes. Requires pd_json_paths_filter to be set with comma-separated paths (e.g., "os_name,model,vendor"). Query with ungrouped=true.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.pd_raw_json
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Pd Raw Json
dimensions.description: Raw json of individual providers

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_eoxs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID EOXs
dimensions.description: Array of end-of-X categories (eol, eos, eossec) for this asset's indicator rule IDs, looked up from asset_eox_rule_id_dictionary. Positionally aligned with indicator_rule_ids. For display names, use indicator_rule_ids_eoxs_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_eoxs_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID EOXs label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for indicator_rule_ids_eoxs (e.g., "End of Life", "End of Standard Support", "End of Security Support") as a JSON array. Use for display instead of indicator_rule_ids_eoxs.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_milestones
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID Milestones
dimensions.description: Array of time-to-deadline milestones (pastdue, within30d, greaterthan30d, greaterthan90d) for this asset's indicator rule IDs, looked up from asset_eox_rule_id_dictionary. Positionally aligned with indicator_rule_ids. For display names, use indicator_rule_ids_milestones_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_milestones_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID Milestones label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for indicator_rule_ids_milestones (e.g., "Past Due", "Within 30 Days") as a JSON array. Use for display instead of indicator_rule_ids_milestones.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID Types
dimensions.description: Array of asset dimensions (device or os) the EOX rules apply to, for this asset's indicator rule IDs, looked up from asset_eox_rule_id_dictionary. Positionally aligned with indicator_rule_ids. For display names, use indicator_rule_ids_types_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Indicator Rule ID Types label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for indicator_rule_ids_types (e.g., "Device", "OS") as a JSON array. Use for display instead of indicator_rule_ids_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_values
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) TagsValues
dimensions.description: A single tag value from the merged user and system tags, returned as one row per distinct value, regardless of which key it belongs to. Empty tag values are excluded, so no blank or null row appears. Use for value suggestion lists before a key has been chosen. Query it on its own with a limit, and do not set ungrouped, because ungrouped removes the grouping that makes the values distinct. Supports a contains filter for typeahead. For values under one specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key. For key names, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.length_combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Length of combined_tags
dimensions.description: Count of tags on the asset across both user and system tags. Filter equals 0 for untagged assets, or greater than 0 for assets that have at least one tag. Also use when asking how many tags an asset has or sorting by tag count. For the tags themselves, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.rowCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Row Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight - Provider Data (Aggregated, Expanded) Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.
