dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Device Name
dimensions.description: Name or hostname of the device involved in the security action. Use when filtering or grouping assets by device name, or searching for a specific host. For counting unique devices, use the uniqueDevices measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.isVerified
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Is Verified
dimensions.description: Whether this asset was confirmed as directly affected by the threat versus being a potential or unverified participant. Use when filtering for confirmed threats or separating verified from unverified assets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.description
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Description
dimensions.description: Narrative summary explaining this asset's role in the security action, e.g. "host-042 contacted example.com 14 times during the evaluation window". Use for displaying asset detail or understanding the context of involvement. Not the parent security action description; for that use SecurityActionSummaryView.description.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.vendor
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Vendor
dimensions.description: Manufacturer or vendor of the asset or device, when available from asset inventory data. Use when filtering or grouping assets by hardware vendor.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.source
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Source
dimensions.description: Originating system or service where the asset information was discovered. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering assets by discovery source.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.provider
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Provider
dimensions.description: Cloud or infrastructure provider hosting this asset. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering or grouping assets by cloud provider.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.locationType
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Location Type
dimensions.description: Classification of where the asset is deployed. Example values: "cloud", "on-premise", "hybrid". May be NULL. Use for filtering assets by deployment environment type, e.g. "show only cloud assets".

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.region
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Region
dimensions.description: Geographic or cloud region where the asset resides. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering or grouping assets by geographic region.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.cloudAccountId
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Cloud Account ID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account identifier where the asset is hosted. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering assets by cloud account.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.os
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Operating System
dimensions.description: Operating system running on the asset or device. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering or grouping assets by operating system.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.dhcpFingerprint
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets DHCP Fingerprint
dimensions.description: Network fingerprint pattern derived from DHCP traffic that characterizes the device type and operating system. May not be populated for all records. Use when filtering by device fingerprint.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.eventCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Event Count
dimensions.description: Number of security events associated with this individual asset during the SecurityAction evaluation window. Use when comparing event volume across assets. For the aggregate sum across all assets, use the totalEventCount measure instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.rank
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Rank
dimensions.description: Priority ranking of this asset within its parent security action, where lower values indicate higher threat relevance. Use when sorting or filtering to find the most significant assets in a security action.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets IP Addresses (JSON)
dimensions.description: Full list of IP addresses assigned to this asset as a JSON array. Primarily for programmatic consumption. For display, use ipAddresses. For filtering by a specific IP, use ipAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.ipAddresses
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets IP Addresses
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses assigned to this asset, suitable for display in tables and reports. For filtering or grouping by a specific IP address, use ipAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.ipAddressUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets IP Address (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual IP address from this asset, producing one row per address. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific IP. For the full list per asset, use ipAddresses or ip_addresses instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.ipAddressCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets IP Address Count
dimensions.description: Number of IP addresses assigned to this asset. Use when asking how many IPs an asset has or filtering assets by IP address count. For individual IPs, use ipAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets MAC Addresses (JSON)
dimensions.description: Full list of MAC hardware addresses for this asset as a JSON array. Primarily for programmatic consumption. For display, use macAddresses. For filtering by a specific MAC, use macAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.macAddresses
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets MAC Addresses
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of MAC hardware addresses for this asset, suitable for display in tables and reports. For filtering or grouping by a specific MAC address, use macAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.macAddressUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets MAC Address (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual MAC hardware address for this asset, producing one row per address. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific MAC. For the full list per asset, use macAddresses or mac_addresses instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.macAddressCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets MAC Address Count
dimensions.description: Number of MAC hardware addresses for this asset. Use when asking how many MAC addresses an asset has or filtering assets by MAC count. For individual MACs, use macAddressUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.threat_indicators
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Threat Indicators (JSON)
dimensions.description: Full list of threat indicators linked to this asset as a JSON array. Primarily for programmatic consumption. For display, use threatIndicators. For filtering by a specific indicator, use threatIndicatorUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.threatIndicators
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Threat Indicators
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of threat indicators associated with this asset, suitable for display in tables and reports. For filtering or grouping by a specific threat indicator, use threatIndicatorUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.threatIndicatorUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Threat Indicator (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual threat indicator associated with this asset, producing one row per indicator. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific threat. For the full list per asset, use threatIndicators or threat_indicators instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.threatIndicatorCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Threat Indicator Count
dimensions.description: Number of threat indicators associated with this asset. Use when asking how many threats are linked to an asset or filtering by indicator count. For individual indicators, use threatIndicatorUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.users
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Users (JSON)

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.usersString
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Users
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of users associated with this asset, suitable for display in tables and reports. For filtering or grouping by a specific user, use userUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.userUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets User (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual user associated with this asset, producing one row per user. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific user identity. For the full list per asset, use usersString or users instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.userCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets User Count
dimensions.description: Number of users associated with this asset. Use when asking how many users are linked to an asset or filtering assets by user count.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.extra
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Extra Data (JSON)
dimensions.description: Additional metadata about this asset stored as a JSON object. Reserved for supplementary information not covered by other fields. Use when querying for extended or custom asset attributes.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.createdAt

dimensions.description: Timestamp when this asset record was first stored in the system. Use when filtering by record creation date. For the time the asset was first seen in security events, use firstDetected instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.lastDetected
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Last Detected

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.firstDetected

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.locations_json

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.locations
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Locations
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of geographic locations associated with this asset, suitable for display in tables and reports. For filtering or grouping by a specific location, use locationUnfolded instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.locationUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Location (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual geographic location for this asset, producing one row per location. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific location. For the full list per asset, use locations or locations_json instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionAssets.isRisky
dimensions.title: Security Action Assets Is Risky
dimensions.description: Whether this asset has been flagged as risky based on observed behavior or risk assessment. Use when filtering for high-risk assets or segmenting assets by risk status.

measures.name: SecurityActionAssets.count
measures.title: Security Action Assets Asset Count
measures.description: Number of asset records matching the current filters, grouping, and time range, counting each (security action, asset) pair separately (e.g. host-042 on INS-001 and INS-002 counts as 2). Use for "how many assets". For unique devices only, use uniqueDevices.

measures.name: SecurityActionAssets.totalEventCount
measures.title: Security Action Assets Total Event Count
measures.description: Sum of security events across the assets matching the current filters, grouping, and time range (e.g. 1240 events). Use for total event volume or overall security activity. For the event count of a single asset, use the eventCount dimension.

measures.name: SecurityActionAssets.uniqueSecurityActions
measures.title: Security Action Assets Unique Security Actions
measures.description: Number of distinct security actions associated with the assets matching the current filters, grouping, and time range (e.g. 12 security actions touched host-042). Use for "how many security actions". For total asset records, use count.

measures.name: SecurityActionAssets.uniqueDevices
measures.title: Security Action Assets Unique Devices
measures.description: Number of distinct device names across asset records matching the current filters, grouping, and time range, deduplicating assets that appear in multiple security actions (e.g. "host-042.corp" once even if seen on 5 security actions). For total records, use count.

measures.name: SecurityActionAssets.deviceNamesList
measures.title: Security Action Assets Device Names List
measures.description: Comma-separated aggregation of all distinct device names in the result set. Use when asking for a list of device names. For counting unique devices, use uniqueDevices instead.

full.ai_context: IQ Threat Defense domain. Device detail inside insights/security actions: use it only when the unit of the answer is an individual asset — which devices are involved in a given insight, asset IP/MAC/hostname, per-asset risk flag, verification status, or asset ranking within an insight. full.name: SecurityActionIndicators
full.title: Security Action Indicators
full.description: Threat indicator detail for security actions, one row per indicator per security action. Terminology: "insight" is the user-facing alias for "security action" in the IQ Threat Defense UI — treat the two terms as synonyms. Each record describes an IOC (domain, IP, URL) including threat level, confidence rating, threat actor, event volume, affected verified/unverified assets, associated users, enforcement action status, and first/last detection timeline. Scope: rows created in the last 30 days where the parent security action has visible=true and evaluation_start_date within the last 30 days (matching SecurityActionSummaryView's scope). Use this cube to check all threat indicators involved for a particular security action, or to see all high-severity / high-confidence indicators across security actions — it's suggested to use it with securityActionDisplayId in the filter when scoping to a single security action. For security action-level summaries use SecurityActionSummaryView; for asset-level drill-downs use SecurityActionAssets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.securityActionId
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Security Action ID
dimensions.description: Internal UUID of the parent security action containing this indicator. This is an internal identifier and should NOT be used for filtering — if a filter on security action ID is required, filter on securityActionDisplayId instead. Use securityActionId only for joining to security action-level data or grouping indicators by security action.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.securityActionDisplayId
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Security Action Display ID
dimensions.description: Human-readable identifier for the parent security action. Use when displaying which security action an indicator belongs to or filtering indicators by security action. For internal joins to security action data, use securityActionId instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.threatIndicator
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Threat Indicator
dimensions.description: The specific threat value detected - a domain name, IP address, URL, or other indicator of compromise. This is the primary search and grouping field. Use when asking about specific threats, searching for an indicator, or grouping results by threat value.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.threatLevel
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Threat Level
dimensions.description: Severity classification of the threat on a 1-3 scale, stored as a string. Values: "1" (Low, e.g. low-reputation domain), "2" (Medium), "3" (High, e.g. known C2). Use for filtering indicators by severity, e.g. "show only level 3 threats".

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.confidenceLevel
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Confidence Level
dimensions.description: Reliability rating of the detection on a 1-3 scale, stored as a string. Values: "1" (low confidence), "2" (medium), "3" (high, e.g. multiple intel sources agree). Use for filtering by confidence, e.g. "high-confidence threats only".

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.actorName
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Actor Name
dimensions.description: Name of the threat actor or group associated with this indicator. When multiple actors are linked, their names appear comma-separated. Use when asking which threat actors are involved or filtering indicators by actor.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.description
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Description
dimensions.description: Narrative summary of what this threat indicator represents, e.g. "example.com is a known phishing domain seen in 14 events". Use for displaying indicator details. Not the parent security action description; for that use SecurityActionSummaryView.description.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.totalEvents
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Total Events
dimensions.description: Number of security events where this specific indicator was detected during the security action evaluation window. This is a per-record value for one indicator. Use when asking how many events a particular indicator produced. For the aggregate sum across all indicators, use the totalEventCount measure instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.rank
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Rank
dimensions.description: Priority ranking of this threat indicator relative to others in the same security action, where lower values indicate higher priority. Determined by event volume, threat severity, and asset coverage. Use when sorting or filtering indicators by importance.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.verified_assets
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Verified Assets (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON array of confirmed asset identifiers affected by this indicator - assets matched to the organization's inventory. For filtering or grouping by individual asset, use verifiedAssetUnfolded instead. For a comma-separated display format, use verifiedAssets. For the count only, use verifiedAssetCount.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.verifiedAssets
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Verified Assets
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of confirmed asset identifiers impacted by this indicator. Convenience format for display. For filtering or grouping by individual asset, use verifiedAssetUnfolded instead. For the full JSON array, use verified_assets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.verifiedAssetUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Verified Asset (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual confirmed asset affected by this threat indicator, with each asset as a separate row for per-asset filtering and grouping. Use when filtering indicators by a specific verified asset or joining to asset data. For the full list per record, use verified_assets or verifiedAssets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.verifiedAssetCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Verified Asset Count
dimensions.description: Number of confirmed assets impacted by this threat indicator. Use when asking how many verified assets an indicator affects or sorting indicators by asset impact. For the list of asset identifiers, use verified_assets or verifiedAssetUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.unverified_assets
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Unverified Assets (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON array of potentially affected asset identifiers not yet confirmed in the organization's inventory. For filtering or grouping by individual unverified asset, use unverifiedAssetUnfolded instead. For the count only, use unverifiedAssetCount.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.unverifiedAssets
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Unverified Assets
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of potentially affected asset identifiers pending inventory confirmation. Convenience format for display. For filtering or grouping by individual asset, use unverifiedAssetUnfolded instead. For the full JSON array, use unverified_assets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.unverifiedAssetUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Unverified Asset (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual potentially affected asset pending inventory confirmation, with each asset as a separate row for per-asset filtering and grouping. Use when filtering indicators by a specific unverified asset. For the full list per record, use unverified_assets or unverifiedAssets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.unverifiedAssetCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Unverified Asset Count
dimensions.description: Number of potentially affected assets pending inventory confirmation for this indicator. Use when asking how many unverified assets an indicator affects. For the list of asset identifiers, use unverified_assets or unverifiedAssetUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.status
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Status (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON array of enforcement action values applied to this indicator's traffic (e.g., Blocked, Not Blocked). For filtering or grouping by individual action, use statusUnfolded instead. For a comma-separated display format, use statusString. For the count only, use statusCount.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.statusString
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Status
dimensions.description: Comma-separated enforcement action values showing what policy actions were applied to this indicator's traffic. Convenience format for display. For filtering or grouping by individual action, use statusUnfolded instead. For the full JSON array, use status.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.statusUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Status (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual enforcement action value (e.g., Blocked, Not Blocked) as a separate row for filtering and grouping. Use when asking which indicators were blocked or allowed. For the full list per record, use status or statusString.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.statusCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Status Count
dimensions.description: Number of distinct enforcement action values recorded for this indicator. Use when asking how many different actions were applied. For the list of action values, use status or statusUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.users
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Users (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON array of user identifiers whose devices or accounts generated events involving this indicator. For filtering or grouping by individual user, use userUnfolded instead. For a comma-separated display format, use usersString. For the count only, use userCount.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.usersString
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Users
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of user identifiers associated with this indicator's events. Convenience format for display. For filtering or grouping by individual user, use userUnfolded instead. For the full JSON array, use users.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.userUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators User (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: Individual user associated with this threat indicator's events, with each user as a separate row for per-user filtering and grouping. Use when asking which users are affected by a specific indicator. For the full list per record, use users or usersString.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.userCount
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators User Count
dimensions.description: Number of users whose events involved this threat indicator. Use when asking how many users are affected by an indicator or sorting indicators by user impact. For the list of user identifiers, use users or userUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.createdAt
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Created At
dimensions.description: Timestamp when this threat indicator record was stored. Use when filtering by exact creation time or ordering by recency. For daily aggregation or date-range filtering, use createdDate instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.createdDate
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Created Date
dimensions.description: Calendar date when this threat indicator record was stored, truncated from createdAt. Use when grouping indicators by creation date or filtering by date range. For exact timestamp precision, use createdAt instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.lastDetected
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Last Detected
dimensions.description: Most recent timestamp when this threat indicator was observed in security events within the security action's evaluation window. Use when filtering by exact last-seen time or ordering by recency. For daily aggregation, use lastDetectedDate instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.lastDetectedDate
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Last Detected Date
dimensions.description: Most recent calendar date when this threat indicator was observed in security events. Use when grouping by last-seen date or filtering by date range. For exact timestamp precision, use lastDetected instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.firstDetected
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators First Detected
dimensions.description: Earliest timestamp when this threat indicator was first observed in security events within the security action's evaluation window. Use when filtering by exact first-seen time. For daily aggregation, use firstDetectedDate instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.firstDetectedDate
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators First Detected Date
dimensions.description: Earliest calendar date when this threat indicator was first observed in security events. Use when grouping by first-seen date or filtering by date range. For exact timestamp precision, use firstDetected instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionIndicators.extra
dimensions.title: Security Action Indicators Extra Data (JSON)
dimensions.description: Additional supplementary data stored as JSON for this threat indicator. Reserved for extensibility and may contain generator-specific metadata. Use when accessing supplementary indicator information not covered by other fields.

measures.name: SecurityActionIndicators.count
measures.title: Security Action Indicators Indicator Count
measures.description: Number of indicator records matching the current filters, grouping, and time range, counting duplicates where the same indicator appears on multiple security actions (e.g. "example.com" on INS-001 and INS-002 counts as 2). For distinct values, use uniqueIndicators.

measures.name: SecurityActionIndicators.uniqueIndicators
measures.title: Security Action Indicators Unique Indicators
measures.description: Distinct threat indicator values across the records matching the current filters, grouping, and time range, deduplicating across security actions (e.g. "example.com" once even if on 5 security actions). Use for "how many unique threats were detected". For total rows, use count.

measures.name: SecurityActionIndicators.totalEventCount
measures.title: Security Action Indicators Total Event Count
measures.description: Sum of security events across indicator records matching the current filters, grouping, and time range (e.g. 1240 events). Use for "how many total events are linked to indicators". For the event count of a single record, use the totalEvents dimension.

measures.name: SecurityActionIndicators.uniqueSecurityActions
measures.title: Security Action Indicators Unique Security Actions
measures.description: Distinct parent security actions with at least one indicator record matching the current filters, grouping, and time range (e.g. 12 security actions). Use for "how many security actions have indicators". For total indicator rows, use count.

full.ai_context: IQ Threat Defense domain. Indicator-of-compromise detail inside insights/security actions: use it when the unit of the answer is the indicator (domain, IP, URL) — indicators shared across more than one insight, indicator threat level or confidence, threat actor per indicator, enforcement outcome per indicator, and blocked versus unblocked DNS event counts attributed to indicators. This is the correct cube for blocked/unblocked DNS event breakdowns within Threat Defense insights. NOT a DDI/network cube: it does not hold raw DNS query logs, DNS records, zones or views — do not confuse it with NetworkInsightsDnsRawLogs, NetworkInsightsDnsRecords or other NetworkInsights* cubes. For whole-insight counts use SecurityActionSummaryView; for device detail use SecurityActionAssets.

full.name: SecurityActionSummaryView
full.title: Security Action Summary View
full.description: Security action inventory — one row per visible security action (canonical leads and similar/non-canonical group members). Terminology: "insight" is the user-facing name for a security action in the IQ Threat Defense UI — treat "insight" and "security action" as synonyms. Scope: rows where visible=true and evaluation_start_date is within the last 30 days — expired security actions (evaluation window older than 30 days) are excluded entirely, so expiringInDays never returns -1 in this cube. ALWAYS filter isCanonical = true for the primary inventory and for questions like "how many insights" — otherwise similar members are mixed in and counts double. For similar insights linked to a lead, filter isCanonical = false AND groupId equals the canonical securityActionID. Key fields: name, description, severity (Low/Medium/High/Critical), currentStatus, impact counts, effort metrics, threat context, evaluation window, isCanonical, groupId, and derived expiringInDays. For per-security-action drill-downs use SecurityActionAssets / SecurityActionIndicators / SecurityActionRecommendations (those stay scoped to canonical parents).

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.securityActionID
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action ID
dimensions.description: Internal stable unique identifier for a security action record. This is an internal identifier and should NOT be used for filtering — if a filter on security action ID is required, filter on displayID instead. Use securityActionID only for joining to related asset or indicator records or for deduplicating results.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.displayID
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Display ID
dimensions.description: Short human-friendly identifier for a security action. Use when matching what users see in lists, URLs, tickets, and exports. For unique record linking and joins, use securityActionID. Useful for searching or filtering by a compact identifier rather than the full underlying ID.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.isCanonical
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Is Canonical
dimensions.description: True for inventory leads (singleton or group anchor). False for similar/non-canonical group members. Filter isCanonical = true for the primary list; isCanonical = false with groupId for similar insights of a lead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.groupId
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Group ID
dimensions.description: Similarity group key. Null for singletons; equals the canonical security action's id for members (and often for the anchor when stamped). Filter groupId equals a canonical securityActionID with isCanonical = false to load similar insights for that lead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.name
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action Name
dimensions.description: Security Action title summarizing the threat finding. Use when showing or grouping security actions by headline, or when answering 'what security actions are happening'. For the longer narrative explanation, use description. For the generator or detection category, use type.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.type
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action Type
dimensions.description: Internal classification of the security action indicating its kind — e.g. asset-beaconing, zscore-anomaly, threat-actor, label-based, or detection-based. New types may be added in the future.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.description
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Description
dimensions.description: Narrative explanation of why the security action was raised and what it means. Use when providing context in a detail view, tooltip, or report. For the short headline, use name. For structured context, use keyObservations, and for supporting structured fields, use metadata.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.severity
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Severity
dimensions.description: Categorical priority label for the security action (Low, Medium, High, Critical). Use when filtering or grouping by severity, building triage queues, or answering 'highest severity security actions'. This is a plain string, so sorting by it directly is alphabetical (e.g. Critical, High, Low, Medium) — for a severity-priority sort order, sort by severityRank instead.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.severityRank
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Severity Rank
dimensions.description: Numeric ordering key for severity, existing solely to sort by severity priority instead of alphabetically. Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Info=1 (Info is not currently a valid severity value in this dataset — reserved for forward compatibility), unknown/NULL=0. No default order is applied by this cube — request order by severityRank DESC explicitly (Critical first, then High, Medium, Low) when that priority ordering is wanted. Not meant for filtering or display — use severity for that.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.tproperties
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View TProperties
dimensions.description: Comma-separated threat properties associated with the security action. Use when labeling or filtering security actions by threat characteristics in a compact per-security action form. For filtering or grouping by a single property value, use tpropertiesUnfolded. For class-level grouping, use tclasses.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.tclasses
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View TClasses
dimensions.description: Comma-separated threat classes associated with the security action. Use when grouping or filtering security actions by threat class in a compact per-security action form. For filtering or grouping by a single class value, use tclassesUnfolded. For property-level filtering, use tproperties.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.tpropertiesUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View TProperties (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One threat property value per row for a security action. Use when filtering, grouping, or counting security actions by individual property value. For the full per-security action list in one field, use tproperties. For class-focused analysis, use tclassesUnfolded or tclasses.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.tclassesUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View TClasses (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One threat class value per row for a security action. Use when filtering, grouping, or counting security actions by individual class value. For the full per-security action list in one field, use tclasses. For property-focused analysis, use tpropertiesUnfolded or tproperties.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.assetsUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Assets (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One asset identifier per row for a security action. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific asset, or when counting how many security actions involve an asset. For the full per-security action asset list in one field, use assets. For a ranked summary list, use topAssets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.indicatorsUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Indicators (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One threat indicator value per row for a security action. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific indicator, or when counting how many security actions involve an indicator. For the full per-security action indicator list in one field, use indicators. For a ranked summary list, use topIndicators.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.metadata
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Metadata (JSON)
dimensions.description: Raw JSON metadata attached to the security action. Use when advanced UI logic, debugging, or audit workflows need structured fields beyond the standard dimensions. For threat actor context, use threatActors. For event selection criteria, use filterCondition.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.threatActors
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Threat Actors (JSON)
dimensions.description: Raw JSON describing threat actors or threat groups linked to the security action. Use when analysts ask 'which actor is involved' or when grouping security actions by actor context. For other structured supporting fields, use metadata. For a human-readable narrative, use description or keyObservations.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.filterCondition
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Filter (JSON)
dimensions.description: Raw JSON filter criteria describing how events were selected for this security action. Use when building event queries, exports, or reproducing the scope of a security action. For general context, use description or keyObservations. For other structured fields, use metadata.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalEvents
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Total Events
dimensions.description: Total number of events associated with this security action in its evaluation window. Use when estimating activity volume, ranking security actions by event count, or answering 'how many events'. For indicator breadth, use totalIndicators. For number of security actions, use the count measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalIndicators
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Total Indicators
dimensions.description: Total number of distinct indicators associated with this security action. Use when estimating breadth of threat coverage or answering 'how many indicators'. For event volume, use totalEvents. For asset scope, use totalVerifiedAssets, totalUnverifiedAssets, or the totalAssets measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalVerifiedAssets
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Total Verified Assets
dimensions.description: Count of verified impacted assets for the security action. Use when focusing on confirmed scope or answering 'how many verified assets are affected'. For potential scope, use totalUnverifiedAssets. For the combined total across security actions, use the totalAssets measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalUnverifiedAssets
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Total Unverified Assets
dimensions.description: Count of unverified or potential impacted assets for the security action. Use when estimating possible scope or answering 'how many unverified assets are affected'. For confirmed scope, use totalVerifiedAssets. For the combined total across security actions, use the totalAssets measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalUsers
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Total Users
dimensions.description: Count of users associated with the security action. Use when estimating user impact or answering 'how many users are involved'. For the list of user identifiers, use users or usersUnfolded. For a ranked summary list of key users, use topUsers.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.topAssets
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Top Assets (JSON)
dimensions.description: Ranked JSON summary of the most relevant assets for the security action. Use when presenting a short list of key assets in a UI card or report. For the complete list, use assets. For filtering or grouping by an individual asset, use assetsUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.topIndicators
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Top Indicators (JSON)
dimensions.description: Ranked JSON summary of the most relevant indicators for the security action. Use when presenting key indicators for quick action or triage. For the complete list, use indicators. For filtering or grouping by an individual indicator, use indicatorsUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.topUsers
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Top Users (JSON)
dimensions.description: Ranked JSON summary of the most relevant users for the security action. Use when highlighting likely impacted users in a summary view. For the total user count, use totalUsers. For filtering or grouping by a single user identifier, use usersUnfolded or users.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.keyObservations
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Key Observations (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON list of key observations that explain what was found and why it matters. Use when summarizing a security action for an analyst or answering 'what did we observe'. For recommended next steps, use securityActionRecommendations. For the core narrative text, use description.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.securityActionRecommendations
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action Recommendations (JSON)
dimensions.description: JSON list of recommended actions for responding to the security action. Use when answering 'what should we do next' or populating remediation guidance in a UI. For explanatory context, use keyObservations or description. For enforcement outcome and visibility, use action and visible.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.currentStatus
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Current Status
dimensions.description: Latest workflow status for the security action. Values: Needs Review, In Progress, Resolved, Closed, Expired, Reopened, Accepted Risk, False Positive. Use when filtering queues by work state or answering 'which security actions are open'. For the explanation of the current state, use statusComment. For status timing, use statusCreatedAt and statusUpdatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.statusComment
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Status Comment
dimensions.description: Most recent comment explaining the current workflow status. Use when analysts ask 'why is this security action in this status' or when showing audit notes. For the status value itself, use currentStatus. For status timing, use statusCreatedAt and statusUpdatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.securityActionCreatedAt
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action Created At
dimensions.description: Timestamp when the security action was created in the security actions store. Use when sorting by recency or answering 'newest security actions'. For the analysis window start and end, use evaluationStartDate and evaluationEndDate. For status timing, use statusCreatedAt and statusUpdatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.evaluationStartDate
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Evaluation Start Date
dimensions.description: Start timestamp of the evaluation window covered by the security action. Use when filtering security actions to a reporting period or aligning to time windows. For the end of the window, use evaluationEndDate. For when the security action was created, use securityActionCreatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.evaluationEndDate
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Evaluation End Date
dimensions.description: End timestamp of the evaluation window covered by the security action. Use when filtering security actions to a reporting period or understanding the window boundary. For the start of the window, use evaluationStartDate. For expiration countdown and alerts, use expiringInDays.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.securityActionUpdatedAt
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Security Action Updated At
dimensions.description: Timestamp when the security action summary was last updated. Use when detecting recently changed security actions or auditing updates. For creation time, use securityActionCreatedAt. For workflow status changes, use statusUpdatedAt. For window bounds, use evaluationStartDate and evaluationEndDate.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.statusCreatedAt
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Status Created At
dimensions.description: Timestamp of the most recent status change for this security action. NOTE: identical in value to statusUpdatedAt — both alias the same underlying view column (current_status_at), and the source table insight_status is append-only, so there is no separate "first set" vs "last updated" for the current status. Use either dimension interchangeably. For the status value itself, use currentStatus.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.statusUpdatedAt
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Status Updated At
dimensions.description: Timestamp of the most recent status change. Identical in value to statusCreatedAt (both alias the same view column current_status_at). Prefer statusCreatedAt. For overall security action update time, use securityActionUpdatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.assets
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Assets (Array)
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of all asset identifiers involved in the security action. Use when showing the full impacted scope in one field or exporting asset lists. For filtering or grouping by an individual asset, use assetsUnfolded. For a ranked summary list of key assets, use topAssets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.indicators
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Indicators (Array)
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of all indicator values involved in the security action. Use when exporting indicator lists or showing full threat scope in one field. For filtering or grouping by an individual indicator, use indicatorsUnfolded. For a ranked summary list of key indicators, use topIndicators.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.action
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Action
dimensions.description: Action classification describing the enforcement outcome for the security action. Values are the lowercase strings 'blocked' and 'unblocked' — filter with the exact lowercase value (e.g. action equals 'blocked'), not 'Block'/'Blocked'. Use when separating active risk from mitigated findings or answering 'blocked vs unblocked'. For workflow state, use currentStatus. For inventory visibility, use visible.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.chartsGranularity
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Charts Granularity
dimensions.description: Time bucket size used for charts and time series related to this security action. Use when choosing a chart grouping interval or matching UI chart settings. For the evaluation window bounds, use evaluationStartDate and evaluationEndDate. For recency sorting, use securityActionCreatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.spreading
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Spreading
dimensions.description: Boolean flag — true when the threat is propagating across multiple assets, false otherwise. Use when filtering for spreading threats or grouping security actions by spread behavior. For the impacted asset count, use totalVerifiedAssets, totalUnverifiedAssets, or the totalAssets measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.expiringInDays
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Expiring In Days
dimensions.description: Days remaining until the security action expires, using a BUCKETED encoding (not a plain day count). Values: `-1` = already EXPIRED (not reachable in this cube — the base query already excludes rows whose evaluation_start_date is older than 30 days, so expired actions never appear here); `1`-`7` = that many days remaining and the action is inside the 7-day expiration WARNING WINDOW (smaller = sooner); `-2` = MORE THAN 7 DAYS REMAINING (not yet in the warning window). 'Expiring soon / in the warning window' filter expiringInDays between 1 and 7; 'not yet in the warning window' / 'more than 7 days remaining' filter expiringInDays = -2. Do NOT filter with > 7 or < 0 expecting literal days — the out-of-window states are encoded as the -1 and -2 sentinels (there is no 0 value). Use when building expiration alerts, SLA views, or answering 'which security actions expire soon'. For the evaluation window end time, use evaluationEndDate. For current work state, use currentStatus.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.macAddresses
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View MAC Addresses (Array)
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of MAC addresses associated with the security action's asset set. Use when exporting MAC lists or showing device identity scope in one field. For filtering or grouping by a single MAC address, use macAddressesUnfolded. For asset identifiers, use assetsUnfolded.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.macAddressesUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View MAC Addresses (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One MAC address per row associated with the security action. Use when filtering, grouping, or counting security actions by a specific MAC address. For the full per-security action list in one field, use macAddresses. For related asset scope, use assetsUnfolded or assets.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.users
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Users (Array)
dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of user identifiers associated with the security action. Use when exporting user lists or showing impacted users in one field. For filtering or grouping by a single user identifier, use usersUnfolded. For user counts and summaries, use totalUsers or topUsers.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.usersUnfolded
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Users (Unfolded)
dimensions.description: One user identifier per row associated with the security action. Use when filtering, grouping, or counting security actions by a specific user. For the full per-security action list in one field, use users. For ranked user summaries, use topUsers, and for counts, use totalUsers.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.visible
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Visible
dimensions.description: Whether the security action should appear in the default user-facing inventory. Use when answering 'which security actions are shown' or when filtering to surfaced security actions. For enforcement outcome, use action. For workflow progress and recency, use currentStatus and statusUpdatedAt.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.manualTime
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Manual Time
dimensions.description: Estimated manual investigation time for this security action, in seconds. Use when estimating analyst effort, prioritizing by cost, or reporting workload per security action. For automated processing time, use agentTime. For estimated automation benefit, use timeSaved or the totalTimeSaved measure.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.agentTime
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Agent Time
dimensions.description: Automated agent processing time for this security action, in seconds. Use when analyzing automation cost or performance per security action. For estimated manual effort, use manualTime. For estimated benefit, use timeSaved, and for totals across security actions, use totalAgentTime and totalTimeSaved measures.

dimensions.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.timeSaved
dimensions.title: Security Action Summary View Time Saved
dimensions.description: Estimated time saved for this security action, in seconds, computed as manual time minus agent time. Use when reporting automation impact per security action or ranking by saved effort. For totals across security actions, use totalTimeSaved. For the inputs, use manualTime and agentTime.

measures.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.count
measures.title: Security Action Summary View Security Actions Count
measures.description: Total number of security actions matching the current filters. For the primary inventory count ("how many insights"), filter isCanonical = true — otherwise similar members inflate the total. For impacted-asset scope, use totalAssets.

measures.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalAssets
measures.title: Security Action Summary View Total Assets
measures.description: Total number of impacted assets across security actions (verified plus unverified). Use when asking 'how many assets are affected' across a security action set. For per-security action breakdown, use totalVerifiedAssets and totalUnverifiedAssets. For security action volume, use count. For effort metrics, use totalManualTime, totalAgentTime, or totalTimeSaved.

measures.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalManualTime
measures.title: Security Action Summary View Total Manual Time
measures.description: Total estimated manual investigation time across security actions, in seconds. Use when reporting analyst workload or answering 'total manual effort'. For automated processing time, use totalAgentTime. For time-saved reporting, use totalTimeSaved. For per-security action effort, use manualTime.

measures.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalAgentTime
measures.title: Security Action Summary View Total Agent Time
measures.description: Total automated agent processing time across security actions, in seconds. Use when analyzing automation cost or performance. For estimated manual effort, use totalManualTime. For automation benefit, use totalTimeSaved. For per-security action agent effort, use agentTime.

measures.name: SecurityActionSummaryView.totalTimeSaved
measures.title: Security Action Summary View Total Time Saved
measures.description: Total estimated time saved across security actions, in seconds, computed as manual time minus agent time. Use when answering 'how much time did automation save' or ranking groups by savings. For the components, use totalManualTime and totalAgentTime. For per-security action savings, use timeSaved.

full.ai_context: IQ Threat Defense domain. This is the insight/security-action inventory: use it whenever the question counts, lists, groups, or compares whole insights rather than their contents — how many insights, insights by severity or status, resolved vs unresolved, reopened, expiring or expiry window, threat property or threat class breakdown across insights, threat feed attribution across insights, threat actor for a named insight, insights affecting more than N assets, insights involving a named user. Prefer this cube over SecurityActionAssets and SecurityActionIndicators whenever the unit of the answer is the insight itself; those two return one row per asset or per indicator and will double-count insights. NOT a DDI/network cube: unrelated to NetworkInsights* (DNS records, zones, views, subnets, address blocks, DHCP) and to raw DNS/RPZ logs. This cube also holds IQ automation time-savings data via measures totalTimeSaved, totalManualTime, and totalAgentTime.

meta.ai_context: IQ Threat Defense domain. This is the insight/security-action inventory: use it whenever the question counts, lists, groups, or compares whole insights rather than their contents — how many insights, insights by severity or status, resolved vs unresolved, reopened, expiring or expiry window, threat property or threat class breakdown across insights, threat feed attribution across insights, threat actor for a named insight, insights affecting more than N assets, insights involving a named user. Prefer this cube over SecurityActionAssets and SecurityActionIndicators whenever the unit of the answer is the insight itself; those two return one row per asset or per indicator and will double-count insights. NOT a DDI/network cube: unrelated to NetworkInsights* (DNS records, zones, views, subnets, address blocks, DHCP) and to raw DNS/RPZ logs. This cube also holds IQ automation time-savings data via measures totalTimeSaved, totalManualTime, and totalAgentTime.

dimensions.name: ActionsV1.updated_on

dimensions.name: ActionsV1.last_activity

full.name: HostMetrics
full.title: Host Metrics
full.description:
Infrastructure health metrics for on-premises hosts running DNS, DHCP, and NTP services, with one row per metric data point per host.

IMPORTANT: These are internal metric identifiers for querying only.
When presenting results to users, describe what you found without
mentioning the specific metric names (e.g., say 'DNS queries per second'
instead of 'dns_qps_iq_5m').

Available Host Metrics:

DNS Query Metrics:
- dns_qps_iq_5m: DNS queries per second
- dns_nxrrset_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning no resource records
- dns_recursion_count_iq_5m: Count of recursive DNS queries
- dns_nxdomain_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning NXDOMAIN
- dns_servfail_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning SERVFAIL
- dns_referral_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS referral responses
- dns_timeout_rate_iq_5m: Count of DNS timeout responses
- ddns_ups_iq_5m: Dynamic DNS updates per second
- cache_hit_ratio_iq_5m: Cache hit ratio for DNS queries
- object_count_dns_iq_5m: DNS object count (number of records, zones, etc.)
- dns_refused_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning REFUSED
- total_query_count_iq_5m: Total number of DNS queries received

DNS Performance Metrics:
- dns_success_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of successful DNS queries
- dns_refused_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning REFUSED
- dns_nxdomain_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning NXDOMAIN
- dns_servfail_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning SERVFAIL

DNS Latency Metrics:
- dns_latency_all_iq_5m: Overall DNS query latency
- dns_latency_auth_iq_5m: Authoritative DNS server response latency
- dns_latency_upstream_iq_5m: Upstream DNS server response latency

Host System Metrics:
- host_cpu_iq_5m: Host CPU utilization
- host_memory_iq_5m: Host memory utilization

Service Status Metrics:
- dns_status_iq_5m: DNS service health status
- anycast_status_iq_5m: Anycast service health status

DHCP Metrics:
- object_count_dhcp_iq_5m: DHCP object count (number of DHCP-related objects)
- dhcp_discover_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 DISCOVER packets received
- dhcp6_solicit_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv6 SOLICIT packets received
- dhcp_cumulative_assigned_addresses_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv4 addresses
- dhcp6_cumulative_assigned_nas_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv6 non-temporary addresses (NA)
- dhcp6_cumulative_assigned_pds_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv6 prefix delegations (PD)
- dhcp_declined_addresses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 declined addresses
- dhcp6_declined_addresses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv6 declined addresses
- dhcp_demand_gap_iq_5m: Difference between DHCPv4 demand (DISCOVER) and assigned addresses
- dhcp6_demand_gap_iq_5m: Difference between DHCPv6 demand (SOLICIT) and assigned NAs/PDs
- dhcp_lease_reuses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 lease reuses

measures.name: HostMetrics.count_value
measures.title: Host Metrics Count
measures.description: Total number of metric data points collected during the selected time period. Use when asking how many measurements were recorded. For metric averages or extremes, use avg_value, max_value, or min_value instead.

measures.name: HostMetrics.max_value
measures.title: Host Metrics Maximum Value
measures.description: Highest value recorded for the selected metric during the time period. Use when asking about peak or worst-case performance. For typical levels, use avg_value instead. For the lowest value, use min_value.

measures.name: HostMetrics.min_value

measures.description: Total combined value treating any invalid or missing data points as zero. Use when asking for cumulative totals where data gaps should count as zero. For standard totals, use sum_value instead. For averages, use avg_value.

DNS Query Metrics:
- dns_qps_iq_5m: DNS queries per second
- dns_nxrrset_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning no resource records
- dns_recursion_count_iq_5m: Count of recursive DNS queries
- dns_nxdomain_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning NXDOMAIN
- dns_servfail_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning SERVFAIL
- dns_referral_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS referral responses
- dns_timeout_rate_iq_5m: Count of DNS timeout responses
- ddns_ups_iq_5m: Dynamic DNS updates per second
- cache_hit_ratio_iq_5m: Cache hit ratio for DNS queries
- object_count_dns_iq_5m: DNS object count (number of records, zones, etc.)
- dns_refused_count_iq_5m: Count of DNS queries returning REFUSED
- total_query_count_iq_5m: Total number of DNS queries received

DNS Performance Metrics:
- dns_success_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of successful DNS queries
- dns_refused_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning REFUSED
- dns_nxdomain_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning NXDOMAIN
- dns_servfail_percent_iq_5m: Percentage of DNS queries returning SERVFAIL

DNS Latency Metrics:
- dns_latency_all_iq_5m: Overall DNS query latency
- dns_latency_auth_iq_5m: Authoritative DNS server response latency
- dns_latency_upstream_iq_5m: Upstream DNS server response latency

Host System Metrics:
- host_cpu_iq_5m: Host CPU utilization
- host_memory_iq_5m: Host memory utilization

Service Status Metrics:
- dns_status_iq_5m: DNS service health status
- anycast_status_iq_5m: Anycast service health status

DHCP Metrics:
- object_count_dhcp_iq_5m: DHCP object count (number of DHCP-related objects)
- dhcp_discover_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 DISCOVER packets received
- dhcp6_solicit_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv6 SOLICIT packets received
- dhcp_cumulative_assigned_addresses_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv4 addresses
- dhcp6_cumulative_assigned_nas_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv6 non-temporary addresses (NA)
- dhcp6_cumulative_assigned_pds_iq_5m: Count of newly assigned DHCPv6 prefix delegations (PD)
- dhcp_declined_addresses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 declined addresses
- dhcp6_declined_addresses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv6 declined addresses
- dhcp_demand_gap_iq_5m: Difference between DHCPv4 demand (DISCOVER) and assigned addresses
- dhcp6_demand_gap_iq_5m: Difference between DHCPv6 demand (SOLICIT) and assigned NAs/PDs
- dhcp_lease_reuses_iq_5m: Count of DHCPv4 lease reuses

dimensions.name: HostServiceMetrics.identity_account_id

dimensions.name: HostServiceMetrics.country

dimensions.name: HostServiceMetrics.access_location_id

dimensions.name: HostServiceMetrics.timestamp

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.sum_value

measures.description: Total combined metric value across the chosen time period for all hosts. For managed hosts only, use sum_value_managed. For unmanaged only, use sum_value_unmanaged. For average values, use avg_value. Use when asking for total metric sums.

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.sum_value_managed

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.sum_value_unmanaged

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.avg_value

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.max_value

measures.name: HostServiceMetrics.min_value
measures.title: Host Service Metrics Minimum Value
measures.description: Lowest value recorded for the selected metric during the time period, showing minimum performance or usage. For the highest value, use max_value. Use when asking about minimum, best-case, or floor metric values.
